coordinate_order.gps_points: explicit named fields 'lon' (WGS84 degrees East) and 'lat' (WGS84 degrees North)
coordinate_order.predicted_route_geometry: coordinates_lon_lat is [[from_lon, from_lat], [to_lon, to_lat]] (GeoJSON lon,lat order)
coordinate_order.road_network_context: coordinates_lon_lat is [[from_lon, from_lat], [to_lon, to_lat]] (GeoJSON lon,lat order)

missing_value_conventions.unmatched_gps_point: pred_arc_id=null and pred_prob=null when no road candidate exists
missing_value_conventions.unavailable_reference_route: evaluation_available=false and reference-dependent metrics set to null
